_comment: Config for connect_stray_pads — connects a STRAY unconnected pad (a pad on a net that IS otherwise routed/poured, so route_pcb_simple / route_pcb_astar skip the net as 'done' and never route this one pad). It reads DRC's own unconnected_items (each gives the stray pad's point AND a point on the same-net copper), routes a stub between them, and DRC-VALIDATES every candidate — accepting only one that removes the unconnected item and adds NO short. Tries the back layer first (the front is usually where the blocking net sits), diagonal then L-shaped. Nothing is hardcoded: layers, width, order all here. Cached; RESTART backend after edits.
_rule_source: Diagnosed 2026-07-02: routers treat a net with any copper as routed, leaving stray pads (e.g. C3.+5V behind +12V). Fix = per-pad stub on the clear layer, DRC-verified.
